hooks.command: in=$(cat); printf '%s' "$in" | "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/tools/py "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/.claude/hooks/protect_learner_work.py 2>/dev/null && exit 0; p=$(printf '%s' "$in" | grep -oE '"(file_path|notebook_path)"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"'); p=${p##*"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"}; case "${p:-$in}" in *workspace/*|*projects/*|*workspace\\*|*projects\\*|*solution*) printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"The learner-work check could not run (Python missing?), so edits to workspace/, projects/ and solution files are blocked. Run the setup skill first."}}';; esac; exit 0
